title: Meta Quest (VR)
description: A model for the Meta Quest VR headset. The headset has a mobile GPU and shared system memory, so we keep geometry and textures genuinely light.

availableExtensions.title: KTX2 texture compression
availableExtensions.description: Converts textures to a GPU format: saves up to ~80% of video memory — especially valuable for Quest with its shared memory. Requires KTX2 (basisu) support in the app.
availableExtensions.impact: The file may grow 5–10%, but texture video memory drops several-fold.

availableExtensions.title: Draco geometry compression
availableExtensions.description: Minimal file weight (often −50% on geometry). Decodes slower than Meshopt but is supported everywhere.
availableExtensions.impact: The file is noticeably lighter; decoding on open is slower.

availableExtensions.title: Remove vertex colors
availableExtensions.description: Removes painted vertex colors. Enable only if vertex colors are not visible in the model (white channels are removed without this option too).
availableExtensions.impact: Saves 5–20% of size if colors exist; may change the look if they were used.

notes: triangles 100000 — a conservative budget for a single object: Meta's recommendations for Quest allow 350–500k triangles for the whole frame, so we leave headroom for the environment and other objects.
drawCalls 50 — Meta's recommendation for Quest: 50–100 draw calls per frame; for a single object we take the lower bound.
textureMaxSize 1024 — Meta's recommendation: on the headset's mobile GPU keep textures small (1K), 2K only for large surfaces.
vramMB 64 — guideline: Quest shares memory with the system, so saving video memory is critical for stable FPS.
fileMB 8 — guideline: less data loads into the headset's memory.
noKtx true — v0.0.8: baseline plan without KTX2 (textures stay PNG/WebP); KTX2 is an extension enabled by explicit user choice.
texMode mixed — if the user enables the ktx2 extension: the headset's mobile GPU needs savings, color textures in the lightest format.
extension id = core feature name: web-interface passes the selected ids to optimizeFile as advancedFeatures; the opts field is the equivalent for the legacy path.
